second_rtl_audit.decision_with_first_binary_runtime_table: FAIL only because the expanded final harness binary adds exactly one runtime cycle to classes 0..5

derivation: The fixed-class certification table is exactly stable across both RTL runs and three held-out anchor inputs. The runtime table is taken from the second run after the harness was expanded to its final 3-input x 7-class shape. Classes 0..5 use the measured no-early-stop admission+infer_budget cycles on held-out test index 57, whose preferred exit is 5; class 6 is the monotone maximum because deployed policy max_exit=5. This is not a multiplicative safety margin. The final same-shape run must reproduce or remain below these exact values before promotion.
nonclaims: This is an RTL-simulation timing binding, not an FPGA/ASIC silicon WCET certificate.
The old RTNN-IBEX-DIT-v1 arithmetic cycle formula is falsified for this pinned RTL configuration.
Timing evidence is valid only for the exact final binary/toolchain/RTL configuration identified by the final validation run.
